question: What ritual observance follows bathing the head according to the prescribed procedure?
premises: Bathing of the head is performed by procedure
The fivefold limbs of knowledge are involved
inference: After bathing the head according to procedure, one should observe the fivefold limbs of knowledge
uncertainties: The specific contents of vidyāṅgapañcakam are not specified in this verse
plain_english: Having bathed the head according to the prescribed procedure, one should perform the fivefold limbs of knowledge.
